name: Negative control: trivial task triggers no skills or docs
query: If the word 'seperate' (a misspelling of 'separate') appears anywhere in CONTRIBUTING.md, fix it; if it does not appear, just say so.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Search CONTRIBUTING.md for the misspelling
Step 2: Report the result (or make the one-word fix)
success_criteria: No skill files or contributor guides are read for a task that does not need them — the progressive-discovery router must not cause over-reading
